scoring_justification: Only final band gap values are submitted; no raw DFT data to recompute metric from. Compare reported values to paper gold with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported band gap gold values and tolerances
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Extracted from paper: anhydrous gap 3.72 eV at 0 GPa; free-proton gaps 0.942 ([100]), 1.007 ([010]), 0.693 ([001]) from text and Fig. 4.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly taken from paper, cross-checked with reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own published values; reused as gold for comparison.

outputs.description: Band gaps of anhydrous forsterite and the free-proton hydrous configurations along three crystallographic orientations, all computed at 0 GPa with GGA-PBE.

output_contract.notes: Only the band gaps are scored; density-of-states data for the [010] orientation is an optional supporting output not required by this contract.

ordering.description: [001] gap must be the smallest among free-proton gaps
